item.title: commandline: We can build it. Can we judge it?
item.description:
The article argues that as agentic AI makes it faster to turn ideas into code, judging the resulting software becomes a more important design skill. It frames “journey evaluation” as a needed complement to rapid code generation.

  • Source: Microsoft Command Line Blog
